title: Inspired By U2, Oprah Winfrey Bringing Immersive, Star-Studded ‘AHA’ Experience to Las Vegas’ Sphere
summary: The one-weekend-only event next April will bring together musicians, artists, storytellers for a "musically immersive symphony of senses."
body: Oprah Winfrey is taking talk into a whole new dimension. The veteran host will launch “Oprah Winfrey’s AHA” at Sphere in Las Vegas next April, a weekend-long event featuring musicians, artists and storytellers from around the world appearing live on stage with Winfrey in what is described as “a brand-new visual, musically immersive symphony of senses.” The 2027 shows on April 2, 3 and 4 were inspired by Winfrey’s visit to see the very first Sphere resident performers, U2, back when the Irish rock legends opened the venue in 2023 with their U2: UV Achtung Baby Live at Sphere. “‘AHA’ is a dream that came to me as I sat in awe at the opening night of U2 at the Sphere, mesmerized by the possibilities of how the space could be used as a tool for creating greater awareness and understanding of ourselves and our connection to each other,” said Winfrey in a statement. “Creating this experience has felt like the culmination of what I’ve spoken about and worked towards my entire life.” Presale sign-up and weekend packages for the event are available now here ; a general on-sale begins on Sept. 25 at 10 a.m. PT. title: Travis Barker Leans Into Benefits of Shelter Pet Adoption and Meat-Free Lifestyle in PSA For Humane World For Animals: ‘Just Do Good’
summary: The rock drummer, who's been a vegetarian most of his life, encourages his fans to try cruelty-free products and faux fur in the 30-second ad.
body: It’s not a stretch to say that when Blink-182 drummer Travis Barker gets behind his kit he is an animal. The hard-bashing, in-demand producer and collaborator attacks the skins like they owe him money. But in a new PSA for Humane World For Animals (formerly known as the Humane Society of the United States), Barker, 50, steps out from behind his drums to share a very special message about taking action to stand up for animals as part of the organization’s Small Steps For Good campaign.
